title: AP Community 360° Canonical Data Model — Table-by-Table Reference
description: One JSON object per Iceberg table in ap_community360, generated directly from scripts/ap_community360_ddl.sql so the column list/types here can never drift from the live DDL. Every field carries a plain-language description. Community 360 is a companion model to Citizen 360: it does not modify or duplicate Citizen 360's tables, and instead joins into them through one shared conformed dimension — dim_geography (geo_level/district_name/mandal_name/village_habitation) — resolved against Citizen 360's dim_district/dim_mandal/dim_village by NAME at query time, since the two models are independently-owned Iceberg databases with no direct foreign key between them. The facility model itself follows a supertype/subtype pattern: dim_facility holds what every facility has in common, and dim_facility_type.subtype_table routes each facility to its type-specific attribute table (dim_facility_school, dim_facility_hospital, etc.), so the schema grows by adding a new subtype table rather than widening one table with hundreds of mostly-NULL columns per type.

relatedModel.joinLogic: ap_community360.dim_facility.geography_id -> ap_community360.dim_geography.geography_id, then dim_geography.district_name/mandal_name/village_habitation matched by name against ap_citizen360.dim_district.district_name / dim_mandal.mandal_name / dim_village.village_name (the API resolves the Citizen 360 district_id/mandal_id the drilldown nav uses into these names before filtering, since Community 360 has no FK into Citizen 360's id space).

dim_facility_type.description: The controlled vocabulary of facility types (School, Hospital, Anganwadi, Community Center, Park, Govt Office, ...). subtype_table points at the type-specific attribute table for that type (e.g. 'dim_facility_school'), so a consumer can join dim_facility -> dim_facility_type -> the right subtype table without hardcoding the mapping app-side. This is what lets new facility types be added by inserting a row here, not by changing code.

facility_type_id.description: Surrogate key for this facility type. Referenced by dim_facility.facility_type_id and every fact_facility_* table.

type_code.description: Short stable code, e.g. 'HOSPITAL', 'SCHOOL' — safe to use in URLs/filters; won't change even if type_name's display wording does.

type_name.description: Human-readable display name, e.g. 'Hospital'. What the UI shows; what users filter by.

type_category.description: Broad grouping the type belongs to, e.g. 'Health', 'Education', 'Civic' — used for the facility-mix breakdown.

sector.description: Public/Private/Trust sector this type is normally operated under (a default, not a per-facility override — see dim_facility.ownership_type for the actual per-row value).

parent_type_id.description: Self-referencing FK to facility_type_id, for hierarchical types (e.g. a specialty clinic as a sub-type of Hospital). NULL for top-level types.

subtype_table.description: Name of the ap_community360 table holding this type's extra attributes (e.g. 'dim_facility_school'). NULL when a type has no subtype attributes yet (e.g. Govt Office).

governing_department.description: FK-by-name to ap_citizen360.dim_department.department_id — which government department owns/regulates this facility type.

service_norm_radius_km.description: The planning-norm catchment radius for this facility type (e.g. a Hospital should be within 8km) — the yardstick fact_facility_access.within_norm_distance is measured against.

description.description: Free-text description of the facility type for documentation/tooltips.

is_active.description: Whether this type is still in active use for new facility records (retiring a type doesn't delete history).

source_system.description: Upstream system this row was loaded from, e.g. 'udise_plus', 'hmis', 'seed'.

batch_id.description: Load batch identifier — groups every row written by the same ingestion run, for reprocessing/rollback.

load_ts.description: When this row was first written to the canonical table.

updated_ts.description: When this row was last updated (upsert/merge timestamp).

record_status.description: Row lifecycle flag, e.g. 'ACTIVE' | 'RETIRED' — soft-delete marker; rows are never hard-deleted.

dim_geography.description: The conformed geography spine shared with Citizen 360 — this is the join point that lets a Community 360 facility be located against the exact same district/mandal/village hierarchy Citizen 360 uses, without Community 360 owning a second, divergent copy of AP's administrative boundaries. geo_level tells you which columns on a given row are populated: a 'district' row only has district_name filled in; a 'village' row has the full district -> mandal -> village chain. Citizen 360's own dim_district/dim_mandal/dim_village are NOT modified by this table — district_id/mandal_id here are matched by NAME (district_name / mandal_name), resolved from Citizen 360's dim_district.district_id / dim_mandal.mandal_id at query time, since the two models were built independently and don't share a physical foreign key.

geography_id.description: Surrogate key for this geography row. Referenced by dim_facility.geography_id and every fact_facility_* table.

geo_level.description: Which level of the hierarchy this row represents: 'state' | 'district' | 'mandal' | 'village'. Determines which of the columns below are meaningful for this row.

state_name.description: State name — 'Andhra Pradesh' for every row in this deployment.

district_name.description: District name. The field the Community 360 geo filter resolves a Citizen 360 district_id into, then matches against here.

revenue_division.description: Revenue division (a sub-district administrative grouping) this geography sits in, when applicable.

mandal_name.description: Mandal name, populated for 'mandal' and 'village' level rows.

gram_panchayat.description: Gram panchayat (village self-government unit) name, for rural geographies.

ward_name.description: Urban ward name, for ULB (urban local body) geographies instead of gram panchayat.

village_habitation.description: Village/habitation name, populated for 'village' level rows — matched against Citizen 360's dim_village.village_name.

ulb_name.description: Urban Local Body name (municipality/corporation), for urban geographies.

ulb_type.description: Type of ULB, e.g. 'Municipal Corporation', 'Municipality', 'Nagar Panchayat'.

pincode.description: Postal PIN code for this geography, when known at this granularity.

lgd_state_code.description: Local Government Directory (Govt of India) state code — the national standard code for cross-system geography matching.

assembly_constituency.description: State assembly constituency this geography falls in.

parliament_constituency.description: Parliamentary constituency this geography falls in.

boundary_wkt.description: Well-Known-Text polygon of this geography's boundary, for map rendering. NULL where boundary data hasn't been captured.

population.description: Population of this geography — the number district-coverage/citizens-reached rollups sum over the facilities located within it.

area_sqkm.description: Area of this geography in square kilometers — used for density-style metrics.

source_system.description: Upstream system this row was loaded from, e.g. 'udise_plus', 'hmis', 'seed'.

batch_id.description: Load batch identifier — groups every row written by the same ingestion run, for reprocessing/rollback.

load_ts.description: When this row was first written to the canonical table.

updated_ts.description: When this row was last updated (upsert/merge timestamp).

record_status.description: Row lifecycle flag, e.g. 'ACTIVE' | 'RETIRED' — soft-delete marker; rows are never hard-deleted.

dim_facility.description: One row per physical facility, regardless of type — the 'supertype' every facility has in common (name, location, ownership, operational status). Type-specific detail (school/hospital/park/... attributes) lives in the matching subtype table named by dim_facility_type.subtype_table and joined back on canonical_facility_id, instead of one enormous table with hundreds of mostly-NULL columns. Partitioned by facility_type_id since almost every query filters or groups by type. valid_from/valid_to/is_current make this a slowly-changing dimension: a facility that changes operational status doesn't overwrite history, it closes the old row and opens a new one.

canonical_facility_id.description: Canonical, permanent facility identifier — the key every other Community 360 table joins on. Stable even if the facility's upstream source-system code changes.

facility_type_id.description: FK to dim_facility_type.facility_type_id — which type this facility is, and therefore which subtype table (if any) to join for extra attributes.

facility_category.description: Denormalized copy of the type's category (e.g. 'Health', 'Education') for fast filtering without a join.

facility_short_name.description: Short name/abbreviation, for compact UI labels.

ownership_type.description: Actual ownership of this specific facility, e.g. 'Government' | 'Private' | 'Trust' — the per-row value (vs. dim_facility_type.sector's type-level default).

managing_authority.description: The specific department/authority operating this facility (may be more specific than dim_facility_type.governing_department, e.g. a named municipal body).

operational_status.description: Current operational state, e.g. 'Operational' | 'Under Review' | 'Closed' — drives the summary's operational-facilities count and the priority-facilities panel.

geography_id.description: FK to dim_geography.geography_id — the shared-spine join point back to Citizen 360's district/mandal/village.

locality.description: Locality/area name within the geography, for search matching.

pincode.description: Postal PIN code (may be more precise than dim_geography.pincode for the facility's exact location).

latitude.description: Facility's exact latitude, for map plotting and distance calculations.

geohash.description: Geohash of the facility's coordinates, for proximity indexing/clustering. NULL until computed.

h3_index.description: H3 hexagonal grid index of the facility's coordinates, for spatial aggregation. NULL until computed.

boundary_wkt.description: Well-Known-Text footprint of the facility's premises, if captured (e.g. a large hospital campus).

verification_status.description: Data-quality flag, e.g. 'Verified' | 'Pending' — whether a human/field-survey has confirmed this record.

golden_source.description: Which upstream source system is treated as authoritative for this facility's core attributes, when more than one source has contributed data about it.

valid_from.description: Start of this row's validity period (slowly-changing dimension).

valid_to.description: End of this row's validity period; NULL while the row is current.

is_current.description: Whether this is the current version of the facility record — every query filters on is_current = true unless explicitly asking for history.

source_system.description: Upstream system this row was loaded from, e.g. 'udise_plus', 'hmis', 'seed'.

batch_id.description: Load batch identifier — groups every row written by the same ingestion run, for reprocessing/rollback.

load_ts.description: When this row was first written to the canonical table.

updated_ts.description: When this row was last updated (upsert/merge timestamp).

record_status.description: Row lifecycle flag, e.g. 'ACTIVE' | 'RETIRED' — soft-delete marker; rows are never hard-deleted.

dim_facility_identifier.description: Crosswalk of every external code a facility is known by across source systems (UDISE+ code for a school, HMIS code for a hospital, AWC code for an anganwadi, ...). Kept separate from dim_facility instead of adding one column per source system, and separate from the per-type subtype tables since the same facility can accumulate identifiers from multiple systems over time, each with its own confidence/match provenance.

facility_identifier_id.description: Surrogate key for this identifier row.

identifier_type.description: What kind of identifier this is, e.g. 'UDISE_CODE', 'HMIS_CODE', 'AWC_CODE'.

identifier_value_hash.description: Hashed identifier value — stored hashed rather than plaintext since some source-system codes are treated as sensitive/internal.

id_class.description: Classification of the identifier, e.g. 'govt' | 'internal' — informs which consumers are allowed to see/use it.

source_system.description: Upstream system this identifier came from.

match_method.description: How this identifier was linked to the facility, e.g. 'exact' | 'fuzzy' | 'manual' — the entity-resolution method used.

confidence_score.description: Confidence (0-1) that this identifier genuinely belongs to this facility, from the match_method's resolution process.

valid_from.description: Start of this identifier mapping's validity.

valid_to.description: End of this identifier mapping's validity; NULL while active.

is_active.description: Whether this identifier mapping is currently active.

source_batch_id.description: Load batch that produced this identifier mapping.

load_ts.description: When this row was first written.

updated_ts.description: When this row was last updated.

dim_facility_school.description: School-specific attributes, aligned to the UDISE+ (Unified District Information System for Education Plus) national schema, so this table can be reconciled against the UDISE+ feed directly. One row per facility where dim_facility.facility_type_id resolves to the SCHOOL type; joined back to dim_facility on canonical_facility_id. Backs the school-medium/management critical filters in the Community 360 UI.

canonical_facility_id.description: FK to dim_facility.canonical_facility_id — one row per school facility.

udise_plus_code.description: National UDISE+ school code — the authoritative cross-system key for this school.

school_management.description: Who manages the school, e.g. 'Government' | 'Aided' | 'Private Unaided' — one of the critical filter fields.

school_category.description: School category by level, e.g. 'Primary' | 'High School'.
school_category.value_description: ['PRIMARY', 'UPPER PR. AND SECONDARY', 'PRIMARY WITH UPPER PRIMARY', 'PR. UP PR. AND SECONDARY ONLY', 'HIGHER SECONDARY ONLY', 'UP. PR. SECONDARY AND HIGHER SEC', 'PR. WITH UP.PR. SEC. AND H.SEC.', '2', 'UPPER PRIMARY ONLY', '1', '6', '11', '7']

lowest_class.description: Lowest class/grade taught at this school.

highest_class.description: Highest class/grade taught at this school.

board_affiliation.description: Examining board the school is affiliated to, e.g. 'State Board' | 'CBSE'.

medium_of_instruction.description: Primary teaching language, e.g. 'Telugu' | 'English' | 'Urdu' | 'Bilingual' — the other critical filter field.

sanctioned_teachers.description: Sanctioned teacher posts (may exceed total_teachers where there's a staffing gap).

student_teacher_ratio.description: Students per teacher — a standard school-quality indicator.

classrooms_good_condition.description: Classrooms rated in good structural condition.

has_electricity.description: Whether the school has an electricity connection.

has_drinking_water.description: Whether safe drinking water is available.

has_boys_toilet.description: Whether a boys' toilet facility exists.

has_girls_toilet.description: Whether a girls' toilet facility exists.

has_cwsn_toilet.description: Whether a toilet accessible to Children With Special Needs exists.

has_library.description: Whether the school has a library.

has_computer_lab.description: Whether the school has a computer lab.

has_smart_classroom.description: Whether at least one smart/digital classroom exists.

has_boundary_wall.description: Whether the campus has a boundary wall.

has_midday_meal.description: Whether the school serves the midday meal scheme.

internet_available.description: Whether internet connectivity is available at the school.

academic_session.description: Academic year these figures were captured for, e.g. '2025-26'.

source_system.description: Upstream system this row was loaded from, e.g. 'udise_plus', 'hmis', 'seed'.

center_type.description: Type of venue, e.g. 'Kalyana Mandapam' (marriage hall) | 'Community Hall'.

managing_authority.description: Body managing bookings/upkeep of this center.

hall_area_sqft.description: Hall floor area in square feet.

has_kitchen.description: Whether a kitchen/catering area is present.

is_disabled_friendly.description: Whether the venue has step-free/accessible access.

rental_available.description: Whether the venue can be booked by the public.

rental_rate_per_day.description: Daily rental rate in INR, when rental_available is true.

has_lighting.description: Whether the park has lighting for evening use.

project_name.description: ICDS project this centre falls under.

sector_name.description: ICDS sector this centre falls under, within the project.

building_type.description: Where the centre operates from, e.g. 'Own Building' | 'Rented' | 'School Premises'.

registered_pregnant_women.description: Pregnant women currently registered for ante-natal services.

helper_present.description: Whether an Anganwadi helper is currently posted and present.

serves_hot_meal.description: Whether the centre serves a hot cooked meal.

has_preschool_kit.description: Whether pre-school learning kit materials are available.

fact_facility_service.description: Periodic (typically monthly) utilisation/throughput for a facility — footfall, beneficiaries served, revenue. This is what the overview's per-facility 'recent service' history and any utilisation-trend view are built from. One row per facility per period; partitioned by month since queries are almost always time-bounded.

facility_service_id.description: Surrogate key for this service-period row.

facility_type_id.description: Denormalized FK to dim_facility_type.facility_type_id, for fast type-scoped aggregation without a join back to dim_facility.

geography_id.description: Denormalized FK to dim_geography.geography_id, for fast geo-scoped aggregation.

period_date.description: Start date of the reporting period this row covers.

footfall.description: Total visitor/footfall count for the period.

beneficiaries_served.description: Distinct beneficiaries actually served in the period (subset of footfall).

throughput_units.description: Facility-type-specific throughput unit for the period, e.g. patients treated, students taught.

occupancy_pct.description: Capacity utilisation for the period, as a percentage.

revenue_amount.description: Revenue generated in the period, in INR, where applicable (e.g. a rentable community center).

utilization_index.description: Composite utilisation score for the period, combining footfall/occupancy/throughput into one comparable figure across facility types.

source_system.description: Upstream system this row was loaded from, e.g. 'udise_plus', 'hmis', 'seed'.

fact_facility_access.description: The catchment/access bridge: for a given geography, how far away and how well-served is it by a given facility. This is the table that turns 'a facility exists somewhere' into 'this village is/isn't within reach of a hospital' — it's what powers the district access-rate, gap-count, and citizens-in-linked-geographies numbers in the Community 360 overview, all computed relative to dim_facility_type.service_norm_radius_km. Partitioned by facility_type_id since access analysis is almost always scoped to one facility type at a time (e.g. 'hospital access' vs. 'school access').

facility_access_id.description: Surrogate key for this access-bridge row.

geography_id.description: FK to dim_geography.geography_id — the geography this row measures access FROM.

canonical_facility_id.description: FK to dim_facility.canonical_facility_id — the facility this row measures access TO.

distance_km.description: Distance in kilometers from the geography's centroid to the facility.

is_nearest_of_type.description: Whether this facility is the nearest one of its type to this geography (as opposed to just one of several within range).

within_norm_distance.description: Whether distance_km is within dim_facility_type.service_norm_radius_km for this facility's type — the pass/fail flag behind district access-rate and gap-count.

population_served.description: Population of this geography attributed to this facility for service-planning purposes.

households_served.description: Households of this geography attributed to this facility.

computed_date.description: Date this access computation was last run (distances are recomputed periodically, not stored as a live calculation).

source_system.description: Upstream system this row was loaded from, e.g. 'udise_plus', 'hmis', 'seed'.
